synth.notes:
Mirror-blocks/marker game, frame rule: 4x4 grid, a move succeeds iff the destination 4x4 cell is all floor colour 5 (own cells excepted).
Block mode: A1/A2 move both colour-10 blocks up/down 4; A3 moves left block x-4 and right block x+4; A4 does the reverse.
Clicking a colour-9 marker arms/switches (blocks->1, marker->11); clicking colour 1 disarms; while armed, A1-4 move the active marker; A5 is a no-op that still ticks the counter.
